message:
Now I know the issue is OSS-Fuzz 42534457, a heap-buffer-overflow READ 8 in the uswid_fuzzer. Let me look at the git history around that time to find the fix:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/fwupd && git log --all --oneline --since="2024-01-01" --until="2024-06-01" -- libfwupdplugin/fu-coswid-firmware.c | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
